observation: An unauthenticated client without Origin can list rooms, reuse another display name and read its room history.
ICE configuration including a configured TURN credential is returned without authentication. Probe used dummy credentials only.
A different localhost Origin is accepted, including arbitrary ports; Origin is not an access boundary.
Malformed ICE is forwarded. All event types share one rate budget; after enough signaling, call-leave is rejected and the participant remains inCall server-side.
Unknown Upgrade path gets no response and keeps a socket open. Service shutdown waits until the external socket is destroyed.
